verdict.rationale: Attio's first-party pages describe a native natural-language interface, "Ask Attio", which can search, update and create records, draft follow-ups, schedule next steps, build workflows from a described goal, and return live pipeline data. It also supports operating the workspace in natural language through Claude, ChatGPT and other AI tools via an official MCP server, so every element of the story is covered by direct product capability. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of Ask Attio's command scope and behavior (current evidence is marketing copy), independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Ask Attio. Search, update, and create with AI.
Draft follow-ups, update records, schedule next steps, create account briefs. Instantly, not eventually.
Ask Attio to build workflows for you just by describing the goal.
Ask Attio for live data from every conversation in your pipeline.
Manage Attio via AI. Connect Claude, ChatGPT or your AI tool of choice to search, update and manage your Attio workspace.
